6月底，《仙剑三》角色定妆照出炉。

唐人一口气在官网等社交媒体，放出四位主角的定妆照片。

作为大热剧《仙剑奇侠传一》的正统续作，《仙剑三》从立项开始便备受瞩目。

这次公布定妆照和唐人预先的猜测有点不一样。

反响热烈。

但是，一片骂声！！

“靠，胡哥这是什么造型，嘻哈风格？”

“对啊，剧中背景是古代不是现代，哪来的嘻哈风。”

“老胡的造型有点显老哎...是不是得罪造型师？”

“紫萱的造型更不行，我感觉刘施施就不适合紫萱。”

“对啊，紫萱是妖异魅惑，她给我的感觉是清纯！！”

看到这些网上评价的老蔡两眼一黑，差点破口大骂。

老娘花重金打造角色形象，就是为了找骂？

导演李国立在旁边安慰：“这不是还有好评吗？”

顺着他的指引看过去，确实有几条好评。

“看下来只有徐长卿符合游戏人设，仙气飘飘，白衣胜雪！！”

“徐长卿真不错，符合我的审美，晚上抠起来就他了！！”

“哈哈，徐长卿的扮演者是魏沐，一个非常有才华的歌手，他的新专辑马上就要上啦，大家多多支持呀。”

总算不是全员被骂。

蔡怡农长舒一口气，同时感到一丝庆幸。

幸好把徐长卿给了魏沐，否则今天就要全军覆没。

一点闪光掩盖不了实际问题，蔡怡农立刻做出决定。

“老李，你去联系造型师和设计师，我们下午开个会，商量一下怎么办。”

这年头的制作方没有那么高傲，至少愿意虚心接受观众意见。

不像后世，非要找一个普通脸演大美女，死活不听劝。

李国立闻言点点头，随后想起一件事：“对了，橙天那边递过来一份简历，他们想要女主角。”

“女主角？”

蔡怡农皱了皱眉头。

她还想要用女主角签约艺人，这时候橙天横插一脚....

见对方犹豫不决，李国立劝道：“我知道你在想什么，但《红楼梦》那边不愿意放人，我们总不能一直耗着吧？”

唐人为了寻找新艺人可谓煞费苦心，经过数日努力，他们总算找到合适人选。

当红小花——杨蜜

对方与荣信达还剩下4年合约，老蔡想用唐雪见这个角色诱惑杨蜜，让其提前解约加入唐人。

想法很美好，现实很残酷。

At the end of June, the final makeup photos of the characters in "Sword and Sword III" were released.

Tang Ren immediately waited for social media on the official website to release photos of the four protagonists in their final makeup.

As the orthodox sequel to the hit drama "Legend of Sword and Fairy One", "Legend of Sword and Fairy III" has attracted much attention since its inception.

The final makeup photos released this time are a bit different from Tang Dynasty’s pre-speculation.

The response was overwhelming.

However, there was a lot of scolding!!

"Damn, Brother Hu, what kind of look is this? Hip-hop style?"

"Yes, the background of the play is ancient times, not modern times, so where does the hip-hop style come from."

"Lao Hu's style looks a bit old...did he offend the stylist?"

"Zixuan's style is even worse. I feel Liu Shishi is not suitable for Zixuan."

"Yes, Zixuan is enchanting and she makes me feel pure!!"

Lao Cai's eyes darkened when he saw these online comments and he almost cursed.

I spent a lot of money to create a character image just to get scolded?

Director Li Guoli comforted him: "Isn't this still a good review?"

Following his guidance, I did find a few good reviews.

"It seems that only Xu Changqing fits the game's character design, with a fairy spirit and white clothes that beat the snow!!"

"Xu Changqing is really good. It matches my taste. I will pick him at night!!"

"Haha, Xu Changqing is played by Wei Mu, a very talented singer. His new album will be released soon. Please support him."

At least not everyone was scolded.

Cai Yinong breathed a sigh of relief and felt a little lucky at the same time.

Fortunately, Xu Changqing was given to Wei Mu, otherwise the entire army would have been annihilated today.

A little flash couldn't hide the actual problem, so Cai Yinong made a decision immediately.

"Lao Li, please contact the stylist and designer. We will have a meeting in the afternoon to discuss what to do."

The producers these days are not so arrogant, at least they are willing to accept the audience's opinions humbly.

Unlike later generations, who insisted on finding an ordinary face to play the role of a beautiful woman, and refused to listen to advice.

Li Guoli nodded when he heard this, and then remembered something: "By the way, Chengtian handed over a resume. They want the heroine."

"Heroine?"

Cai Yinong frowned.

She also wanted to use the heroine to sign an artist contract, and then Chengtian stepped in...

Seeing the other party's hesitation, Li Guoli advised: "I know what you are thinking, but the people in "Dream of Red Mansions" are not willing to let him go. We can't keep wasting it, right?"

The people of Tang Dynasty worked very hard to find new artists. After several days of hard work, they finally found the right candidate.

Popular little flower——Yangmi

The other party still had 4 years of contract left with Rong Xinda, and Lao Cai wanted to use the role of Tang Xuejian to seduce Yang Mi and let her terminate the contract early to join Tangren.

The idea is beautiful, but the reality is cruel.
